headline: Comelec Prepares for August 29 Cavite Fourth District Special Election
deck: Comelec has scheduled a special election in Cavite's fourth legislative district on August 29, 2026, to fill the House seat vacated after Francisco Barzaga Jr.'s expulsion.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Commission on Elections is preparing for the August 29, 2026 special election in Cavite's fourth legislative district, which covers Dasmariñas City.

sections.heading: What we know
paragraphs: Comelec's official special-election page and Resolution No. 11230 identify the contest as the fourth legislative district of Cavite, not the seventh district stated in the emailed bulletin.

Five aspirants filed certificates of candidacy for the election, according to the Philippine News Agency. The winner will fill the House seat left vacant following the expulsion of Francisco Barzaga Jr.

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: A special election is held to fill a vacant elective position when ordinary succession does not apply. Comelec set the election period and calendar through a formal resolution.

sections.heading: What remains unclear
paragraphs: The bulletin's claim that all official automated ballots had been printed could not be independently established from its accessible links and is not presented here as fact.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The election will restore representation for voters in Dasmariñas City and determine who will occupy the district's seat in the House of Representatives.

sections.heading: What happens next
paragraphs: The campaign and election preparations will proceed under Comelec's official calendar before voting on August 29.
